**Created #557 — openspec sweep hooked to postmerge green path**

**What**: Created issue #557 (https://github.com/csrinaldi/brain/issues/557): backfill archive of ~50 stale change folders + automated sweep step in governance-postmerge.yml + fix dead doctrine references.

**Why**: Follow-up to the openspec lifecycle audit. User proposed hooking the archive to the post-merge verifier ("the one that guarantees everything works independently of gates") — confirmed that component exists: governance-postmerge.yml (D2, #259) runs brain-audit over the governance cursor window; code 0 → advance cursor, code 1 → auto-revert PRs via parse-failures.mjs, code 2 → loud alarm.

**Where**: .github/workflows/governance-postmerge.yml, brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/{cursor,parse-failures,alarm,resolution}.mjs, brain/scripts/archive.mjs, brain/scripts/lib/sdd-layout.mjs.

**Learned** (design constraints agreed in the issue):
- Sweep runs ONLY on clean audit (code 0, after cursor advance) — never mid-incident, since a dirty window may be about to revert the very merge that closed the issue.
- Staleness must NOT become a [FAIL] audit class — that would weaponize the revert machinery against housekeeping. It is a sweep step, not a gate.
- Keyed on issue CLOSED (parseChangeId from folder name), not merely merged.
- Output is an auto-archive PR (same pattern as auto-revert/<sha> branches, PR-head idempotency per REQ-D2-13) — never a direct push to main (branch policy).
- postmerge is the correct home because it is the ONLY trusted writer (contents: write); the PR-time gate must stay read-only (design.md §10-B).
- phase-order-check already models 'archived' as a forward rung, so the archive PR passes Rule B.
- Issue awaits status:approved from maintainer before any PR (brain convention).
